name: FillFormat
description: Represents fill formatting for a shape. A shape can have a solid, gradient, texture, pattern, picture, or semi-transparent fill.
remarks: Many of the properties of the FillFormat object are read-only. To set one of these properties, you have to apply the corresponding method.
example:
Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)

With myDocument.Shapes _

        .AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 90, 90, 90, 80).Fill

    .ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 128, 128)

    .OneColorGradient msoGradientHorizontal, 1, 1

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the background color for the specified fill or patterned line. Read/write.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the foreground color for the fill, line, or shadow. Read/write.

properties.name: GradientColorType
properties.description: Returns the gradient color type for the specified fill. Read-only.

properties.name: GradientDegree
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates how dark or light a one-color gradient fill is. Read-only.

properties.name: GradientStyle
properties.description: Returns the gradient style for the specified fill. Read-only.

properties.name: GradientVariant
properties.description: Returns the gradient variant for the specified fill as an integer value from 1 to 4 for most gradient fills. Read-only.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Sets or returns a value that represents the pattern applied to the specified fill. Read-only.

properties.name: PresetGradientType
properties.description: Returns the preset gradient type for the specified fill. Read-only.

properties.name: PresetTexture
properties.description: Returns the preset texture for the specified fill. Read-only.

properties.name: TextureName
properties.description: Returns the name of the custom texture file for the specified fill. Read-only.

properties.name: TextureType
properties.description: Returns the texture type for the specified fill. Read-only.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified fill, shadow, or line as a value between 0.0 (opaque) and 1.0 (clear). Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represent the type of fill. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets the visibility of the specified object or the formatting applied to the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: GradientStops
properties.description: Returns the GradientStops collection associated with the specified fill format. Read-only.

properties.name: TextureOffsetX
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal offset of the texture from the origin in points. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureOffsetY
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical offset of the texture from the origin in points. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment (the origin of the coordinate grid) for the tiling of the texture fill. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureHorizontalScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal scaling factor for the texture fill. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureVerticalScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical scaling factor for the texture fill. Read/write.

properties.name: TextureTile
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the texture fill is tiled or centered. Read/write.

properties.name: RotateWithObject
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the fill rotates with the specified shape. Read/write.

properties.name: PictureEffects
properties.description: Returns an object that represents the picture or texture fill for the specified fill format. Read-only.

properties.name: GradientAngle
properties.description: Returns or sets the angle of the gradient fill for the specified fill format. Read/write.

methods.name: Background
methods.description: Specifies that the shape's fill should match the slide background. If you change the slide background after applying this method to a fill, the fill will also change.

methods.name: OneColorGradient
methods.signature: OneColorGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long, Degree As Single)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a one-color gradient.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 to 4, corresponding to the four variants on the Gradient tab in the Shape Fill tab. If Style is msoGradientFromTitle or msoGradientFromCenter, this argument can be either 1 or 2.

parameters.name: Degree
parameters.description: The gradient degree. Can be a value from 0.0 (dark) to 1.0 (light).

methods.name: Patterned
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a pattern.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description: The pattern to be used for the specified fill. See Remarks for possible values.

methods.name: PresetGradient
methods.signature: PresetGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long, PresetGradientType As MsoPresetGradientType)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a preset gradient.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be a value from 1 to 4, corresponding to the four variants on the Gradient subtab on the Shape Fill tab. If Style is msoGradientFromTitle or msoGradientFromCenter, this argument can be either 1 or 2.

methods.name: PresetTextured
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a preset texture.

methods.name: Solid
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a uniform color. Use this method to convert a gradient, textured, patterned, or background fill back to a solid fill.

methods.name: TwoColorGradient
methods.signature: TwoColorGradient(Style As MsoGradientStyle, Variant As Long)
methods.description: Sets the specified fill to a two-color gradient.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: The gradient variant. Can be from 1 to 4, corresponding to the four variants on the Gradient sub-tab on the Shape Fill tab. If Style is msoGradientFromTitle or msoGradientFromCenter, this argument can be either 1 or 2.

methods.name: UserPicture
methods.description: Fills the specified shape with one large image.

parameters.name: PictureFile
parameters.description: The name of the picture file.

methods.name: UserTextured
methods.description: Fills the specified shape with small tiles of an image.
